# Service Due

> Service Due is a mobile mechanic in Hobart and Southern Tasmania, Australia. We service cars, utes, vans and fleet vehicles at the customer's home, workplace or work site, so there is no need to drop the car off at a workshop. Backed by 40+ years of hands-on automotive experience.

- Phone: 0472 993 352 (+61 472 993 352)
- Email: bkelly@service-due.com.au
- Area: Hobart and Southern Tasmania, including Kingston, Glenorchy, the Eastern Shore, Sorell, Brighton, New Norfolk and the Huon Valley
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/61594655159954/

## Services

- [Logbook servicing](https://service-due.com.au/services.html): manufacturer-schedule servicing that keeps new-car warranties intact; logbook stamped on site
- [Brakes](https://service-due.com.au/services.html): inspections, pads and rotors using Repco parts that exceed OEM standards
- [Batteries](https://service-due.com.au/services.html): testing and replacement at home or work
- [General maintenance](https://service-due.com.au/services.html): oil and filter changes, fluids, belts, hoses and safety checks
- [Air conditioning](https://service-due.com.au/services.html): air-con checks and servicing
- [Fleet & commercial](https://service-due.com.au/services.html): utes, vans and work vehicles serviced at the depot or site
